title: GraphQL Federation Gateway — Two-Subgraph Runnable Demo
title_es: Gateway de GraphQL Federation — Demo ejecutable de dos subgrafos
description: Runnable TypeScript demo of an Apollo Federation gateway: a users subgraph owning the User entity, a posts subgraph extending it, and an ApolloGateway with IntrospectAndCompose executing a real cross-subgraph query through _entities.
description_es: Demo TypeScript ejecutable de un gateway de Apollo Federation: un subgrafo de users que posee la entidad User, un subgrafo de posts que la extiende y un ApolloGateway con IntrospectAndCompose ejecutando una consulta real entre subgrafos vía _entities.
